title: Chicken Fajita Casserole
reject_reason: Fajita-seasoned chicken with rice and peppers duplicates live fajita-chicken-rice-bowl (shared fajita seasoning, chicken, rice, onions); this estate already ruled the identical chicken-fajita-casserole-with-rice a dupe of the same live dish, and a casserole vs bowl is not a distinct plate in a saturated Tex-Mex region.
